annotation.title_clean: 金融监管总局 工业和信息化部 交通运输部 商务部关于深化改革加强监管促进新能源车险高质量发展的指导意见
annotation.title_en: Guiding Opinions of the National Financial Regulatory Administration, MIIT, Ministry of Transport and Ministry of Commerce on Deepening Reform and Strengthening Supervision to Promote High-Quality Development of New Energy Vehicle Insurance
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家金融监督管理总局; 工业和信息化部; 交通运输部; 商务部
annotation.summary_en: Chinese multi-ministry guidance (2025) on reforming new energy vehicle insurance: lowering repair costs, risk grading of insured vehicle models, pricing reforms, cross-industry data sharing, consumer protection and supervision. It briefly addresses the impact of intelligent driving on motor insurance.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establish insurance vehicle-model risk grading linked to commercial premiums, based on low-speed collision tests
Create a high-loss risk-sharing mechanism and optimise pricing coefficient ranges
Promote compliant cross-industry sharing of NEV data
Study long-term impact of intelligent driving on motor insurance and use telematics for risk reduction
Strengthen consumer protection and supervision of fees and rate filings
